title: Design: New Customer has no Bill Invoices To field without AP/AR access
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Customers → Create & Edit' but not 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' (for example the Foreman role), at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-20-after-new-customer.png, bt-p1-19-before-new-customer.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window has no Bill Invoices To field: State/Province | Country is followed directly by Sales Representative.
  • No empty gap is left where the field would be.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-N1: “Without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', the field is hidden and the window closes up around it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "New Customer" (This build), "New Customer" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
